observations: body L1, L2, L4, L26: the shadda and the fatḥa of «المعدَّل» (L1, L2), «معدَّل» (L4) and «الرَّامِي» (L26) are cast as one sign (4.2-4.3 by 4.0-4.2 points), as in «مقوَّم» on p. 344.
body L3: «مُعَدِّلُ» has the kasra under the shadda of the dāl, a fatḥa on the ʿayn and a damma on the final lām.
body L4: the o of «non» is printed open at the top; transcribed as the letter.

body L6, L8, L9, L17: «٢١» (L6, L9) is a 2 with one crest touching a 1 that rises above it (6.1 points together); «٣٦» (L8, L9) has two crests and a 6 flush with them (7.4-7.6 points), as «٢٦٠» (L17) has one crest and a flush 6.
body L9: the references «٣٠{12}, ٢١{13}» are printed in this order.
body L10: «s v.» is printed without a full stop after the s; transcribed as printed.
body L11: a speck (0.7 point) is printed between «supputatio» and «locorum»; not transcribed.
body L13: «الانتقاليّة» has the shadda alone; «القِرانات» a kasra under the qāf.

body L15: the mark after the ā of «al-Bannā‛» is a small reversed apostrophe (head on top, tail down to the right), for the hamza; transcribed ‛, as printed. The apostrophe of «Abū ’ṣ-Ṣalt» (p. 335) has its tail down to the left.
body L17: the final hamza of «العَذْرَاءُ» is the sort with the damma (3.8 by 5.2 points).
body L21, L23: «الأَسَدِ» (L21) has a kasra under the dāl, «الأَسَد» (L23) none.
body L22, L24: «Ibn Qutaybah» is letter-spaced in L22 and set solid in L24.
body L26: no comma is printed between «Sagittarii» and «٢٧٨».

body L28, L30, L32: a speck (1.0 point) is printed below the line before «Et» (L30) and one (1.4 points) in the left margin (L32); not transcribed. The dots of «« ...» (L28) are printed spaced; transcribed «...».
notes_left L2: «ويسمَّى» has a fatḥa with the shadda of the mīm.
notes_left L3: the gloss «(i. e. علم الازياج)» is set inside the Arabic quotation: «تعديلًا» stands left of it, «للوقت المفروض لهذه الصناعة» right of it; given in reading order.
notes_left L4: «علم» is printed with an elongated join (kashīda), not transcribed. No quotation mark is printed before it.
notes_right L3: the full stop after «الخير» is followed by a reversed apostrophe (2.6 by 3.4 points, head on top, tail down to the right), which closes the quotation; transcribed ‛, as in body L15.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
